headline: Committee files Resolution 25-215, discusses nomination board and claims filing

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: Members voted 9–0 to file Resolution 25-215. They heard the mayor's office supported Resolution 26-93 to dissolve the Independent Nomination Board, and a deputy clerk said changing where claims are filed needs a charter amendment.
meeting.recap: Members voted 9–0 to file (set aside) Resolution 25-215.[[0:10:27]] The mayor's office supported Resolution 26-93, which would dissolve the Independent Nomination Board.[[0:23:08]] A county lawyer advised removing a line about the mayor naming applicants, citing applicant privacy.[[0:27:10]] A 2018 ballot question to move claims failed, 38.8% yes to 43.3% no.[[0:52:20]] The clerks said claimants file with them and get frustrated when clerks cannot share a claim's status.[[0:54:13]] A speaker said the Lahaina and Kula fires and more claims prompted the proposal.[[1:07:39]] A deputy clerk said changing where claims are filed requires a charter amendment, not an ordinance.[[1:24:30]] The clerks said they have never been witnesses in a claim case.[[1:28:28]] The chair called a 10-minute break.[[1:32:22]]
decided: A motion to reconsider the claims proposal was made and seconded, with no vote on it heard in the recording.

moments.q: "The filing or giving of the notice of claim is technically a jurisdictional act for purposes of a lawsuit."
